name: Drata
description: Let agents read your compliance program in Drata: controls, evidence, monitoring tests and what is failing, policies and vendor security reviews. For audit evidence packs and security review drafts.
identity: A Drata API key with read access only.

setup.title: Create a read-only API key
setup.body: Give the key read access only. Choose Custom and tick only the read permissions below, or All read. Drata shows the full key once, so copy it for the form below. You can also limit the key to your deployment's outbound IP addresses.
click: In Drata, select your account at the bottom left, then Settings.
Select API Keys, then Create API Key.
Enter a name and an expiration date (12 months is the default).

Under Access, choose Custom and select: Workspaces: List Workspaces, Company Settings: Get Company Settings, Controls: List Controls, Controls: Get Control, Evidence Library: List Evidence, Monitoring: List Monitors, Monitoring: Get Monitor, Policies: List Policies, Vendors: List Vendors.
Create the key and copy it.

fields.label: API address
fields.help: Where your Drata account is hosted: public-api.drata.com (US), public-api.eu.drata.com (EU) or public-api.apac.drata.com (Asia Pacific).

capabilities.label: Read compliance program
capabilities.description: List workspaces, controls and their evidence, monitoring tests and the resources failing them, and published policies.
capabilities.note: Reaches every workspace unless you keep an agent to chosen workspaces. Read-only.

capabilities.label: Read vendor security reviews
capabilities.description: List security reviews across your vendors: status, decision, deadline and reviewer.
capabilities.note: Needs Drata's third-party risk management plan. Vendor reviews are not kept to workspaces.

limits.label: Workspaces
limits.help: Optional: only these Drata workspaces, by their numeric id (shown under Drata workspaces after connecting). Leave empty for every workspace.

revoke: In Drata, go to Settings, then API Keys, and revoke the key. Agents lose access to Drata at once.
